mintAuthority.summary: STAC uses issuer-administered native token issuance on Ethereum and Solana. On Ethereum, the token is a UUPS proxy whose DSToken implementation permits ISSUER-or-above accounts to mint; the current token-owner EOA is the trust service's unique MASTER and can both mint and authorize upgrades. On Solana, Token-2022 minting and freezing are controlled by the program-owned GSM7ZTDNByoGwayftzcSrDqWmMF9L3mU6KLVrca57j2M account through controller program 7tXjmbkZVY3Gmg9kDBebcNXT1yC5pyoxxXVLwdbv9tvP, whose program upgrade authority 8d36iv2YUD8yDChuVZchx1NqE4qkDWCAEgsUEEUqzbB6 is a single system-owned keypair address with no timelock or on-chain threshold, shared with the controller that mints vbill-vaneck. No liability-side reconciliation is published for either chain: the Chronicle feed carries a net-asset value per token and nothing else, and the Solana leg, which holds the majority of STAC liabilities, is not separately attested.

controls.label: STAC Securitize DSToken issuance surface
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531350, the STAC proxy's EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0x77684815f44b28726bc3efa4471b88ef3b93feb0 and its admin slot was zero. The verified DSToken implementation gates its mint surface with onlyIssuerOrAbove rather than onlyOwner. owner() returned 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee and getRole(owner) returned 1 (MASTER), so the current owner can mint. This review does not claim that the owner is the only account satisfying the issuer-or-above gate.

controls.label: STAC token owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531350, owner() returned 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee and eth_getCode returned 0x, confirming an EOA. getDSService(1) returned DSTrustService 0xec0F580a0FE6eA53654537d34788AeBaD70A6370, where getRole(owner) returned 1 (MASTER). BaseDSContract gates _authorizeUpgrade with onlyMaster; ServiceConsumer accepts the token owner or a trust-service MASTER, and setServiceOwner removes the prior MASTER when assigning the next service owner. The current owner is therefore the terminal current UUPS upgrade authority and, as MASTER, also satisfies DSToken's onlyIssuerOrAbove mint gate.

review.evidence: Ethereum and Solana are both authored as issuer-native STAC deployments, with no third-party bridge machinery in the reviewed route inventory. At Ethereum block 25770050, owner() returned 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee and the EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0x77684815f44b28726bc3efa4471b88ef3b93feb0. At finalized Solana slot 439718934, the Token-2022 mint reported supply 244961279015, mintAuthority and freezeAuthority GSM7ZTDNByoGwayftzcSrDqWmMF9L3mU6KLVrca57j2M, and controller program 7tXjmbkZVY3Gmg9kDBebcNXT1yC5pyoxxXVLwdbv9tvP; its ProgramData reported upgrade authority 8d36iv2YUD8yDChuVZchx1NqE4qkDWCAEgsUEEUqzbB6, a system-owned zero-data account with no resolved timelock or multisig threshold. The Solana authority is therefore a live native mint/freeze path and its controller program is immediately replaceable, but the controller state's signer/governance semantics and off-chain issuance limits remain unresolved. Ethereum DSToken minting is onlyIssuerOrAbove, so the MASTER owner can mint, but the evidence does not establish that no other issuer-level accounts exist. Chronicle continuously and independently verifies STAC holdings and NAV inputs from BNY custody and publishes the results through its public Proof of Asset dashboard; chain-specific Solana liability coverage is not separately exposed. The BVI company and U.S. private-placement exemptions are not product-level prudential supervision. Economic-posture fields remain unbounded issuer-or-above mint and immediate upgrade authority across the native routes, with continuous Chronicle reconciliation and attestation-only supervision. Re-reviewed 2026-08-18. The Chronicle feed 0x9D77E4cA90E25114AFb24dF908f5918f572D958B was read directly: readWithAge() returns exactly two words, a net-asset value per token of 1028.734848 and an age of 2026-08-18T07:44:35Z. It carries no supply term, no liability term and no chain dimension, so it cannot reconcile per-chain token liabilities by construction; Pharos supplies the liability side itself by multiplying that value by Ethereum totalSupply(). At the same time the Solana Token-2022 mint reports 244961.279015 STAC, the larger share of total liabilities, on the chain no published proof covers. The reviewed evidence therefore establishes continuous asset-side and NAV verification but no reconciliation of issuance against reserves, so reconciliation moves from "continuous" to "unknown" rather than crediting an asset-side proof for a liability-side control. Off-chain issuance limits and whether the issuer signing keys are MPC- or HSM-backed remain undisclosed; both are issuer-questionnaire matters and neither can bound an otherwise unbounded mint, so they are recorded here as stated limitations rather than as posture-bearing open questions.
